notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Teferi.
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning The Great Henge from the battlefield to your hand and drawing a card.
Repeat.
